name: Emre Tezmen
current_role: Founder and controlling shareholder of Turkey's Tera group (Tera Yatırım Menkul Değerler, Tera Yatırım Bankası); reported in 2026 to have stepped down as chairman
profile: Turkish financier who trained in Brussels (ULB economics, VUB MBA) and worked in research and institutional sales from 1995 before founding Tera in 2005. He expanded via the Stok Menkul brokerage, factoring (2015) and portfolio management/IT (2020); Tera Yatırım listed on Borsa Istanbul in 2022 and its surge put him and his father on Forbes' 2026 billionaire list.
interesting_fact: The name 'Tera' comes from Terra, the Roman earth goddess symbolising fertility and prosperity; his office displays artefacts from ancient cultures, notably ancient Egypt.
deep_cut_fact: To start Tera in 2005 he sold his house and car, and later put all his savings into acquiring the brokerage Stok Menkul.
notes: Caution: Turkish media (Sept 2026) report he was detained and then arrested in an Istanbul prosecutor's investigation into Tera Portföy funds, with a travel ban; outreach is inadvisable for now. Sources: https://www.ntv.com.tr/ntvpara/emre-tezmen-gorevinden-ayrildi-1742392 . Tera websites were unreachable when checked.

name: Christopher J Nassetta
current_role: President & CEO (and board chair) of Hilton Worldwide Holdings; director of CoStar Group
profile: Chris Nassetta was a real-estate executive (Bristol Group co-founder, then CEO of Host Hotels & Resorts) before becoming Hilton's CEO in 2007 under Blackstone ownership. He led Hilton through its 2013 IPO and 2017 spin-offs into an asset-light franchise giant; his wealth comes chiefly from Hilton stock. He also chairs industry groups such as the US Travel Association.
interesting_fact: He and Hilton's senior executives spend a week each year working hotel jobs such as housekeeping, engineering and front desk.
deep_cut_fact: His first hotel job, from summer 1980 at about 16, was in the engineering department of the Holiday Inn on Capitol Hill, mostly plunging toilets; he likes to say his career 'started in a toilet'.
notes: Highly visible CEO who does lots of media; Hilton corporate communications is the route. breakingnews@ is labelled for urgent media requests; general requests go via the contact page.

name: Qiu Jiajun
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Guobang Pharma Ltd. (国邦医药, SSE: 605507), Xinchang, Zhejiang
profile: Qiu Jiajun (b. 1965), a China Pharmaceutical University graduate and senior engineer, worked at Zhejiang Xinchang Pharmaceutical Factory from 1988 to 1996 before founding Guobang in 1996 as a small county plant making feed additives and veterinary drugs. It grew into a global supplier of antibiotic APIs, intermediates and animal-health products and listed in Shanghai in August 2021, with Qiu still chairman.
interesting_fact: Guobang started in animal health because that market was less crowded, then moved into human APIs; it has ranked among China's top 100 pharmaceutical manufacturers for ten consecutive years (2016–2025).
deep_cut_fact: The company name comes from the phrase 立人立国，兴业兴邦 ('build people, build the nation; grow industry, strengthen the country'). Qiu likens routine products to home cooking and new drugs to fine dishes: you have to master the basics before you can innovate.
notes: Hurun lists him jointly with Chen Jingjing. Board secretary is 彭德光 (per cninfo). Best route is Guobang's investor-relations/securities office.
